name: weak-namespace-pod-rce-v1

attributes.m$K8sThreatMatrix: Lateral Movement::Code execution on pods in unprivileged namespaces

description: determines which subjects can update or patch pods, or create pods/exec, in unprivileged namespaces, which lets them run code on pods that already exist in those namespaces
remediation: Grant update/patch on pods and create on pods/exec only to subjects that genuinely need to debug workloads. Scope such rules with resourceNames where possible, and remove them from long-lived service accounts once debugging is complete.
